title: A Little Too Small a Fit
text: A Little Too Small a Fit. I just wish it was a little bit bigger. Yes, if you use all your might you can squeeze the coffee maker inside and zip it up, but it's not so easy. And no room for anything but the directions pamphlet on the side. LOVE the carrier ..just a little too small.

product_metadata.title: Adir Mini Single Serve Travel Coffee Maker Pouch Organizer, Portable For Travel, Camping, Office Lunch Bag For Grab & Go Daily Use (Black & Green)
features: QUALITY CONSTRUCTION. Expertly crafted using polyester and PVC materials combined with a rugged padded interior, the AdirChef Grab & Go Travel Pouch protects your AdirChef Personal Coffee Maker (sold separately) from damage when you’re traveling.

PROTECT COFFEE MAKER ON THE GO. When you’re traveling and staying in a hotel, you might not have access to a coffee maker and if one is provided, you may question its cleanliness. With this Travel Pouch, you can conveniently carry your coffee maker with you when traveling so you can always enjoy that cup of joe.

SUFFICIENT STORAGE. The green pouch features a zip-open top, outfitted with elastic loops to stow away stirring spoons and a mesh pocket for sweetener packets. A zippered, side compartment keeps wet-naps and coffee packets handy, while mesh end compartments offer additional storage space for other essentials.

COMPACT SIZE. While the pouch is designed specifically to fit your personal coffee maker and accessories, it will fit snugly inside your backpack or suitcase. There’s no need to have to carry it separately or use additional travel bags when packing.

GREAT GIFT IDEA. Combined with the AdirChef Personal Coffee Maker, this Grab & Go Travel Pouch will make a great present for birthdays, holidays and other special occasions. It’s the perfect gift idea for any coffee lover who travels on a regular basis. NOTE: Coffee maker is not included.**Prop 65 Warning - Lead and DEHP**
description: You're traveling and get to your hotel, only to realize that there is no coffee maker in the room. Or worse yet, there's a coffee maker but it looks old and unsanitary. You take your iPod or other personal digital assistant on trips to avoid hotel connectivity charges, and now you can take your coffee maker with you too. This rugged, attractively designed AdirChef Grab & Go Travel Pouch is specifically designed for storing and transporting the AdirChef Grab N' Go Personal Coffee Maker (available for separate purchase). The pouch is durably made with a combination of polyester and PVC materials for long-term strength, along with rugged padded construction to protect the coffee maker from damage. When you unzip the top, you will find two elastic loops to accommodate stirring spoons, along with a mesh pocket for storing sweetener and sugar packets. Additionally, there’s a zippered, side compartment that can house wet-naps, napkins and coffee packets, as well as mesh end compartments to store other essentials to fulfill all your coffee needs. While the pouch is designed to accommodate your coffee maker and accessories, it features a compact size that will fit snugly inside your backpack or suitcase. You don’t have to pack additional bags and can still take your AdirChef with you wherever you go. Traveling, jet lag, different time zones and extensive sightseeing can be extremely exhausting. Don’t get to your hotel and look askance at those in-room coffee makers and blends of questionable cleanliness, age and flavor. Pack your Coffee Maker in the Travel Pouch so you can brew up your favorite blend in minutes and enjoy the same coffee flavor you’ve come to appreciate at home.
